title: Towards Audio Token Compression in Large Audio Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2511.20973v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) deliver strong performance across speech and audio tasks, but their audio encoders generate high-rate token sequences (e.g., 25 tokens/s), making attention computation costly and limiting scalability. In this paper, we explore techniques such as unsupervised segmentation, uniform average pooling, etc., to reduce the number of audio tokens before they are consumed by the LLM decoder. To mitigate potential performance degradation, we employ low-rank adapters during finetuning. We evaluate our proposed models on two tasks, automatic speech recognition and speech-to-speech translation tasks, that are dependent on effectively uncovering the underlying lexical content of the input signal, and study the effect of downsampling on these tasks. Experimental results show that compressed LALMs can achieve performance closer to frame-level LALMs while reducing the input audio token count up to three times

translated_title: 大型音频语言模型中的音频令牌压缩研究
translated_abstract: 大型音频语言模型（LALMs）在语音和音频任务中表现出色，但其音频编码器生成高帧率的令牌序列（例如，每秒25个令牌），这使得注意力计算成本高昂，并限制了可扩展性。在本文中，我们探索了诸如无监督分割、均匀平均池化等技术，以在令牌被LLM解码器消费之前减少音频令牌的数量。为了缓解潜在的性能下降，我们在微调过程中采用低秩适配器。我们在两个依赖于有效揭示输入信号底层词汇内容的任务上评估了我们提出的模型，即自动语音识别和语音到语音翻译任务，并研究了下采样对这些任务的影响。实验结果表明，压缩后的LALMs可以在将输入音频令牌数量减少多达三倍的同时，实现接近帧级LALMs的性能。
tldr: 本文提出通过无监督分割和平均池化等技术压缩音频令牌，并结合低秩适配器微调，使大型音频语言模型在减少三倍输入令牌的情况下仍保持接近帧级性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes compressing audio tokens via unsupervised segmentation and average pooling with low-rank adapter finetuning, enabling large audio language models to achieve near frame-level performance while reducing input token count by up to three times.
